Instructions

This study examines how people use financial information presented in different ways.

During the task, you will be presented with information about stocks in different formats, such as graphs and numerical values. You will then be asked to estimate stock prices.

Your task is to forecast the stock price index of stocks traded on the London Stock Exchange, based on their past price-index values.

A value of 100 means the stock is at its baseline price. A value of 110 means it is about 10% higher, and a value of 90 means it is about 10% lower.

On each screen, you will see a graph showing the stock price index of a stock over the past six periods (#1–#6). You will then be asked to forecast its stock price index in period #10, four periods ahead.

Your forecasts should be in the range of 50–150 index points.

The top 10% of participants who provide the most accurate forecasts will receive a £1 bonus.

When you are ready, click the NEXT button and start answering the questions.
